entities.summary: Reut Naggar is an Israeli producer, cultural entrepreneur and social activist, mainly focusing on LGBT and women's rights. Naggar is the founder and co-owner of WDG, an LGBT news site, and the producer of the theater production "Lesbihonest". Member of the Tel Aviv Jaffa City Council.
